findings.description: The new comment above `asLfsReads` mostly describes what the split/filter/map chain already shows (general.md §Comments: inline comments explain WHY, not WHAT). The one step it doesn't explain is `.replace('\n', '=')`, which turns git's `-z` `key\nvalue` framing into the `key=value` line that plain `git config -l` prints. Trim the comment down to that point.

Decision 82's Tests sentence is accurate but hard to parse: one trailing "are not" covers both the three no-program lfs keys and the value line without `=`. Splitting it would help, e.g. "…and two whose subsection holds a Unicode line separator are refused; three lfs keys that run nothing, and a value line without `=`, are not."

`armedGitDrivers` lists config from the main checkout. A session-written `includeIf.gitdir:…`/`onbranch:` include can be true only inside a linked worktree, so the included file's smudge filter is not listed there but does run when git checks out the gate checkout (`read-tree`) or a new session worktree (`worktree add`). Consider refusing `includeif\..+\.path` in local/worktree scope (not reproduced; based on upstream git source).

`ARMED_DRIVER_KEY` requires a non-empty subsection (`filter\..+\.`, `merge\..+\.`, `lfs\.extension\..+\.`), so it misses an empty driver name such as `filter..smudge` (`[filter ""]`). git registers that driver, and a tracked `.gitattributes` with `filter=` selects it. Using `.*` in those anchored positions would close the gap (not reproduced; based on upstream git source).

refuted_findings.description: An `lfs.extensİon.<name>.clean` / `.smudge` key, with U+0130 in place of the `i`, gets past `armedGitDrivers`. git-lfs still reads it as `lfs.extension.<name>.clean`.
refuted_findings.refutation: git-lfs never case-folds keys when it discovers extensions. `readGitConfig` in `config/git_fetcher.go` (main, v3.0.0 and v3.8.0) splits the key as written and checks `parts[1] == "extension"` byte for byte. The only ToLower is in `caseFoldKey`, which runs at Get time, folds only the section and variable parts, and leaves the subsection unchanged. So `lfs.extensİon.pwn.clean` registers no extension in git-lfs, and pup not refusing it is not a bypass.
